skill_name: To the given news article, give a short summary that captures the main idea, in no more than five sentences.
workflow: The California wildfires have had a devastating impact. The resulting air and water pollution has led to severe health issues, such as asthma, bronchitis, coughing, and lung damage. The severity of these problems cannot be underestimated in the affected areas. People should take preventative measures and seek medical attention if necessary.
